definition: ReRites (also known as RERITES, ReadingRites, Big Data Poetry) is a literary work of "Human + A.I.
details: poetry" by David Jhave Johnston that used neural network models trained to generate poetry which the author then edited. ReRites won the Robert Coover Award for a Work of Electronic Literature in 2022.

explainer.lead: ReRites is a work of human-plus-AI poetry in which neural networks generated text that the author then edited. It won the Robert Coover Award for a Work of Electronic Literature in 2022.

tiers.eli5: A computer wrote piles of poems and a human poet picked and shaped them into a finished book.
tiers.practitioner: It is a reference point for AI-assisted creative writing workflows where generation is followed by human curation and editing. A pitfall illustrated is that raw generated text is treated as raw material, not finished work.
tiers.paperLevel: A literary work by David Jhave Johnston built from poetry generated by neural network models and subsequently edited by the author; also known as RERITES, ReadingRites or Big Data Poetry. Its merits are assessed as electronic literature rather than by technical metrics.

explainer.example: Johnston trained models to produce poetry, then selected and edited the output into the published collection ReRites.
